title: Prescriptions Training Note: The Refill-Eligible Date
content:
Under Kestrel Prescriptions, a routine refill has an earliest date, the refill-eligible date, worked out from the most recent fill of the same prescription.

## Rule

A routine refill is dispensed no earlier than the refill-eligible date, which is the most recent dispensed fill of this prescription plus the refill-eligibility days. The refill-eligibility days are the days supply dispensed on that most recent fill multiplied by the class's early refill threshold percent and divided by 100, with any fraction of a day dropped; the fill date is day 0 and calendar days are counted.

- **Most recent dispensed fill:** the latest original fill, refill, emergency supply or corrected remake of the prescription that has not been returned to stock, as the fill ledger shows.
- **Comparison:** not earlier than; the refill-eligible date itself qualifies.
- **Booked refills:** a refill booked for a later pickup date is dispensed on its booked date, never before the refill-eligible date.
- **Scope:** only a refill with the fill reason routine is subject to this date; early refills for vacation, loss or a dose change are decided by the Prescriptions early refill rules and nothing else.

## Worked through (hypothetical fills)

| Most recent dispensed fill | Class threshold | Refill-eligibility days | Refill-eligible date | Just too early |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 30 days supply on day 0 | 80 percent | 24 | day 24 | day 23 |
| 30 days supply on day 0 | 90 percent | 27 | day 27 | day 26 |
| 14 days supply on day 0 | 90 percent | 12 (12.6 with the fraction dropped) | day 12 | day 11 |
| 90 days supply on day 0 | 80 percent | 72 | day 72 | day 71 |

## Questions answered

**The latest fill on the ledger was returned to stock. Does it set the date?** No. The most recent dispensed fill is the latest one that has not been returned to stock.

**A corrected remake was dispensed after the last refill. Does it count?** Yes. A corrected remake is among the fills that can be the most recent dispensed fill.

**A patient books a routine refill for a pickup date after the refill-eligible date.** It is dispensed on its booked date.
